name: draft_docstring
title: Draft a Waterloo docstring
description: Draft or refine a Waterloo docstring from a callable signature or an existing object.

arguments.name: profile
arguments.description: The Waterloo profile to generate, such as function, method, class, module, type, constant, or variable.

messages.content:
Draft or refine a Waterloo docstring for a $profile object.

If a callable signature is available, use `gen_docstring` with that signature.
If you are revising an existing object, compare `get_signature`, `get_examples`, and `get_references` before proposing wording.

Recommended future workflow: first build a structured authoring-JSON object with the intended profile, contract items, and narrative sections; validate it against its schema; render it into a Waterloo docstring; then validate the actual target object with `waterlint validate`. The authoring-JSON schema and renderer are not implemented yet. Until they are available, use `gen_docstring` as the structural starting point and refine the real docstring iteratively from Waterlint diagnostics. Schema validation can only check structure; final Waterlint validation must still resolve source-specific concerns such as signatures, exception classes, references, and allowed sections.

Prefer normative sections over Notes when the text should state a rule.
